entities.name: Henry I, Bishop of Augsburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri I of Augsburg was the count of Geisenhausen and the bishop of Augsburg from 973 to his death. He succeeded Saint Ulrich of Augsburg. A bellicose warrior-bishop, under him the diocese suffered. Henry was the only son of Burkhard Margrave of Marcha Orientalis and his wife Adelheid, a daughter of Arnulf, Duke of Bavaria.
